decision: Repair only the compiled-resource metadata extraction for the already-consumed positive ten-case component, using one bounded new claim after the prior owner incorrectly released. Do not launch the candidate, replay timing, or run an endpoint.

invalid_resource_attempt.failure: The exact Triton warmup completed, but the collector assumed CompiledKernel.n_regs; that attribute is absent in the pinned runtime. No candidate kernel, timing loop, component case, or endpoint was launched.
invalid_resource_attempt.lifecycle_defect: The owner published repair readiness and then unconditionally released instead of dispatching an extraction-only repair under the live claim.

repair_contract.allowed_operation: Recover the already compiled exact specializations or perform compilation-only warmup, then obtain registers/thread and spill loads/stores from an authoritative pinned-runtime compiler metadata, ptxas, or target-object resource path. Candidate kernel launch is forbidden.
required_causal_diff: Replace only the nonexistent CompiledKernel.n_regs and assumed n_spills access with a proved exact-runtime metadata or target-object extraction path.
Persist the authoritative raw metadata or tool output used for each specialization and bind its digest into the terminal.
Replace the unconditional generic-exception release with a true dispatcher loop that can consume and re-enter an extraction-only repair under the same claim.
required_evidence: Exact candidate source hash, H200 UUID, image digest, Triton version, CUDA target, specialization constexprs, num_warps, compiled object identity, and compiler or target-object identity.
Registers per thread for both exact WRITE_CACHE=True specializations.
Spill stores and spill loads for both specializations from authoritative raw evidence.
Durable proof that no candidate kernel launch, timing loop, component case, checkpoint load, or endpoint request was submitted.
repair_contract.conditional_same_claim_repair_authority: If extraction alone fails before a typed resource terminal, the owner must retain and heartbeat the exact claim, publish a hash-bound diagnostic and repair ID, consume at most one causally narrow extraction-only patch, and re-enter compilation/resource extraction. Do not release on an ordinary metadata API, parser, path, or tool-output mismatch.

disposition.pass: Persist a typed promotion-complete component terminal and release the quiescent bench ready. A later director decides endpoint admission.
disposition.fail: Persist a typed resource-gate negative and release the quiescent bench ready. Preserve the positive component timings as descriptive evidence only.
disposition.recoverable_integration: Retain the exact claim under the dispatcher and apply only a hash-bound extraction repair while the measured restart plus terminal and release fit the absolute deadline.
disposition.unsafe_or_deadline: Release to maintenance with the exact diagnostic.

must: Read this binding once, then prepare and hash-bind the no-launch collector, true-dispatcher owner, and derived execution binding before claim.
Re-read the available exact bench, provider identity, watchdog, and cumulative $1 reservation immediately before claim.
Release by 04:44Z only after a typed resource terminal, an unsafe guest, or the absolute deadline.
must_not: Do not invoke the candidate kernel or replay any consumed component case or timing.
Do not run an endpoint, load the Gemma checkpoint, change candidate source, alter geometry, or weaken acceptance.
Do not create another project, claim another bench, or call provider lifecycle.
Do not release on another ordinary recoverable metadata extraction failure.
